scope.quota_control_config:
# Isolated benchmark fixture. Admission limiting is deliberately disabled.
# Bind the published host port to loopback or an isolated private interface.
[database]
path = "/data/db"
map_size = 8589934592
min_free_disk_bytes = 268435456
[relay]
bind = "0.0.0.0"
port = 7777
nofiles = 0
[relay.abuse]
enabled = true
connection_rate_per_second = 0
event_rate_per_second = 0
pubkey_event_rate_per_second = 0
max_stored_events_per_pubkey = 100000
[observability]
log_format = "json"

attribution_method: Net change in dirty bytes around each synchronous Wok put/del. Includes overflow runs, excludes loose/kept pages. Shared/internal first-touch cost may be charged to the triggering operation; not physical page ownership or flash writes. Final flush adds internal commit work. Instrumented throughput excluded.
